Lexo 1.2.6

  • 🔎 Windows now come to the front. Checking for updates from the menu bar opened Sparkle's window behind the app you were using, so the click seemed to do nothing. The Preferences window had the same flaw. Recent macOS versions refuse to bring a background app forward, so Lexo now raises its windows directly instead of asking to be activated.

Lexo 1.2.5

  • ✍️ Typography. The interface no longer uses em dashes. Same wording, cleaner punctuation, in all 40 languages: commas, colons and periods now do the work, each following the conventions of its own script.

100% on-device · your text never leaves your Mac · no account.

Lexo 1.2.6

  • 🔎 Les fenêtres passent enfin au premier plan. Lancer une recherche de mise à jour depuis la barre des menus ouvrait la fenêtre de Sparkle derrière l'app en cours : le clic semblait sans effet. La fenêtre des Préférences souffrait du même défaut. Les versions récentes de macOS refusent de mettre au premier plan une app d'arrière-plan ; Lexo remonte donc ses fenêtres directement, au lieu de demander à être activé.

Lexo 1.2.5

  • ✍️ Typographie. L'interface n'utilise plus de tirets cadratins. Même formulation, ponctuation plus nette, dans les 40 langues : virgules, deux-points et points prennent le relais, selon les conventions propres à chaque écriture.

100 % local · tes textes ne quittent jamais ton Mac · aucun compte.

Lexo 1.2.5

  • ✍️ Typography. The interface no longer uses em dashes. Same wording, cleaner punctuation, in all 40 languages: commas, colons and periods now do the work, each following the conventions of its own script.

Lexo 1.2.4

  • 🔒 Privacy, in precise terms. Your text never leaves your Mac. The only network connections are macOS downloading Apple's translation models, and Lexo's own update check, which you can switch off in Preferences → About. Earlier wording said “no network requests”, which skipped over that update check; every connection is now documented in PRIVACY.md, along with how to verify it yourself.
  • 🌍 English fallback. Macs set to a system language that isn't one of Lexo's 40 now show the interface in English instead of French.

100% on-device · your text never leaves your Mac · no account.

Earlier wording said “no network requests”, which skipped over that update check; every connection is now documented in PRIVACY.md, along with how to verify it yourself.
  • 🌍 English fallback. Macs set to a system language that isn't one of Lexo's 40 now show the interface in English instead of French.

Lexo 1.2.3

  • 🛡 One instance at a time. Launching Lexo while it is already running (from the mounted DMG, say, while the installed copy is active) now cleanly replaces the old instance instead of coexisting with it. Two simultaneous instances competed for the clipboard, so the shortcut could “translate” previously copied content instead of your selection.

100% on-device · your text never leaves your Mac · no account.
